name: Werewolf
summary: The Werewolf aesthetic is an aesthetic closely tied to the way lycanthropy is used as a metaphor in popular media.
description: The Werewolf aesthetic is an aesthetic closely tied to the way lycanthropy is used as a metaphor in popular media. The Werewolf character often is used to portray the darker side of humanity -- unrestrained, uncontrollable, filled with unbridled rage and lust -- as well as a metaphor for puberty -- mood swings, physical changes out of one's control, hunger, and a cycle closely tied to the moon. Visually, this manifests as typical horror imagery (blood, sharp teeth, dark foggy nights) combined with some key fashion aspects that have become typical to the modern werewolf trope.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Transformation and change, suppressed desires, emotion, lust, hunger, control

visualDNA.colour: Black, grey, brown, blue, red, purple

fashion.Overview: Like the Vampire, the fashion for the Werewolf aesthetic tends to be alternative in nature, though rarely ever fully Goth. Werewolves are depicted as hot-headed hotties who live by their own rules and never deny their true inner nature. This manifests as Werewolf characters adhering to a typical 90s Cool "bad boy" aesthetic, even if they're a woman. Leather jackets and gloves, long dusters, flannels, and combat boots are common here. Their clothes are often ripped or bloodstained, possibly due to being worn during a transformation or fight. They are also tied closely to animal prints and fur of any kind, a hint to their animalistic nature. Male werewolves often opt for jeans, a t-shirt, and…
fashion.Tops: Henley shirts; Flannels; Plain T-shirts, often V-necks; Tank tops; Crop tops; Leather jackets; Jean jackets; Fur-lined jackets and coats
fashion.Bottoms: Dark-wash and black jeans, usually distressed/destroyed; Jean shorts; Skinny jeans; Cargo pants; Camo pants and shorts; Mini, midi, and maxi skirts
fashion.Shoes: Combat boots; Doc Martens; Knee-high boots; Converse; Beat-up sneakers
fashion.Accessories: Layered necklaces; Lockets; Chokers and collars; Ornamental chains; Multiple earrings; Studded and grommet belts; Crosses, moons, animal bones, and gemstones as necklace pendants
